t: Introduction and overview — Midway-class Aircraft Carrier

title: Introduction and overview — Midway-class Aircraft Carrier
description: Introduction and overview of the Midway-class Aircraft Carrier: What this class is, its role in the fleet, and why it matters in naval history. The Midway class — three ships — were the first U.S. carriers too large for the Panama Canal, with armored flight decks. Midway herself served 47 years, from 1945 to Desert Storm in 1991, the longest U.S. carrier career. USS Midway is now a museum in San Diego. Baseline facts: U.S. carrier class; 3 built; armored decks; Midway served 1945-1991 (47 years)..
